spans.text: Blackish-purple cracks tear her body open as the virus sends out savage-looking tendrils.

units.rawText: <color=purple>But that's alright.</color>
units.displayText: But that's alright.

spans.text: But that's alright.

units.rawText: <color=purple>As long as I arrive at the future first and clear a safe path for everyone, that will be enough for me.</color>
units.displayText: As long as I arrive at the future first and clear a safe path for everyone, that will be enough for me.

spans.text: As long as I arrive at the future first and clear a safe path for everyone, that will be enough for me.

units.rawText: <color=purple>Even if it means having to step over Miss Riko's corpse...</color>
units.displayText: Even if it means having to step over Miss Riko's corpse...

spans.text: Even if it means having to step over Miss Riko's corpse...

units.rawText: Ranko's eyes slowly fill with tears, but her gaze is determined.
units.displayText: Ranko's eyes slowly fill with tears, but her gaze is determined.

spans.text: Ranko's eyes slowly fill with tears, but her gaze is determined.

units.rawText: <color=purple>You will be the last Trader to go missing, Miss Riko. Leave the future to me.</color>
units.displayText: You will be the last Trader to go missing, Miss Riko. Leave the future to me.

spans.text: You will be the last Trader to go missing, Miss Riko. Leave the future to me.

units.rawText: ...This level of distortion has completely departed from the realm of being an agent.
units.displayText: ...This level of distortion has completely departed from the realm of being an agent.

spans.text: ...This level of distortion has completely departed from the realm of being an agent.

units.rawText: Do you think this is a form of evolution, Professor?
units.displayText: Do you think this is a form of evolution, Professor?

spans.text: Do you think this is a form of evolution, Professor?
Perhaps.

options.rawText: An agent learning the flaws of humanity should not be considered evolution.
options.displayText: An agent learning the flaws of humanity should not be considered evolution.

spans.text: An agent learning the flaws of humanity should not be considered evolution.

options.rawText: Let's discuss this later when we have time.
options.displayText: Let's discuss this later when we have time.

spans.text: Let's discuss this later when we have time.

units.rawText: Very well. Right now, the star of this stage is this berserk Trader girl...
units.displayText: Very well. Right now, the star of this stage is this berserk Trader girl...

spans.text: Very well. Right now, the star of this stage is this berserk Trader girl...

units.rawText: Give your battle orders, Professor.
